latestVersion.changelog:
En Español Editor AI — Initial Release

- Add Spanish subtitles to video clips via a streamlined cloud workflow.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 in ~30-60 seconds.
- Automatic free token generation for guest users; manages video session and credits.
- Flexible prompts for subtitle generation, aspect ratio, overlays, and audio tracks.
- Robust error handling for file limits, tokens, credits, and export tier.
- Clear mapping of backend API events to user-facing editing actions.
